buckets.name: prod-application-logs
buckets.accessPattern: Write-heavy; read access is rare after 7 days, almost never after 90 days
buckets.note: Largest bucket. 14TB is older than 90 days. No lifecycle policy configured — all data in S3 Standard regardless of age.

buckets.name: prod-media-assets
buckets.accessPattern: Frequent reads via CloudFront; uploads are bursty
buckets.note: Only bucket with any lifecycle policy. Policy only covers thumbnails/ prefix.

buckets.name: prod-data-exports
buckets.accessPattern: Nightly batch exports; accessed by downstream analytics 1-3 days after creation
buckets.note: Data rarely accessed after 7 days. No lifecycle policy.

buckets.name: prod-backups
buckets.accessPattern: Daily writes; reads only during disaster recovery drills (quarterly)
buckets.note: Backup data accessed only during quarterly DR drills. No lifecycle policy.

summary.estimatedSavingsWithLifecyclePolicies: ~$280-320/month if log/export/backup data older than 90 days moved to S3-IA, and data older than 1 year moved to Glacier
